app.title: What Is Your Villain Origin Story? - Villain Origin Test
app.subtitle: What made you the villain?
app.description: 16 rapid-fire binary choices. No thinking, just instinct. Tap left or right to reveal your villain origin story.

betrayed.name: The Betrayed
betrayed.narrative: You were forged in the fires of broken trust. Someone you loved turned their back on you, and the wound never healed. Now you walk through the world with walls so high nobody can reach you. Your pain is your armor, and your memory is your weapon.

mastermind.name: The Mastermind
mastermind.narrative: While others acted on impulse, you learned to think ten steps ahead. Every move is calculated, every word is deliberate. You don't need brute force when you can dismantle someone's entire world with a single phone call. The chessboard is your kingdom.

anarchist.name: The Anarchist
anarchist.narrative: Rules were written by the powerful to keep the powerless in check. You saw through the illusion early. Now you tear down every system, every institution, every comfortable lie. Some call it destruction. You call it liberation.

fallenHero.name: The Fallen Hero
fallenHero.narrative: You started with noble intentions. You wanted to save the world, protect the innocent, be the good one. But the world kept taking and taking until there was nothing left of who you used to be. The hero died. Something darker took its place.

phantom.name: The Phantom
phantom.narrative: You exist in the shadows, unseen and unknown. By the time they realize you were there, it's already too late. You've mastered the art of invisibility, pulling strings from the darkness. No one fears what they can't see — until they do.

conqueror.name: The Conqueror
conqueror.narrative: Power isn't something you want — it's something you are. You were born to command, to dominate, to rule. Every room you enter becomes your throne room. Weakness disgusts you. The world doesn't need saving. It needs a stronger hand.

about.toggle: About the Villain Origin Test & Psychological Archetypes
about.text1: In narrative psychology and literature, villains are rarely born; they are shaped by their coping responses to betrayal, systemic injustice, isolation, or overwhelming pressure. Through 16 rapid-fire binary dilemmas, this reflection examines which classic narrative archetype aligns with your instinctive coping mechanisms.
about.boundary: Self-Awareness Boundary: This experience is an educational and recreational storytelling prompt. It is not a clinical psychological evaluation, personality disorder assessment, or substitute for mental health counseling.
about.dBetrayed: Forged by broken trust; builds impenetrable emotional walls and uses hyper-vigilance as armor.
about.dMastermind: Calculates every outcome; leverages intellectual foresight and detached strategy to maintain complete control.
about.dAnarchist: Disillusioned by rigid social constructs; embraces unpredictability and dismantles confining systems.
about.dFallenHero: Exhausted by selfless devotion without reciprocity; darkens when noble ideals collide with painful reality.
about.dPhantom: Operates quietly from the background; preserves emotional safety through invisibility and indirect influence.
about.dConqueror: Commands through relentless willpower; views vulnerability as a risk and meets obstacles with decisive force.
about.faq1Q: What psychological concepts inspire the Villain Origin Test?
about.faq1A: The test draws on narrative psychology, Jungian archetypes, and psychological defense mechanisms such as rationalization, moral injury, and emotional withdrawal to explore how fictional narratives and personal identities interpret adversity.
about.faq2Q: Does this test diagnose clinical traits or antisocial behavior?
about.faq2A: No. The Villain Origin Test is an educational self-reflection and entertainment experience exploring narrative storytelling archetypes. It is not a clinical assessment, psychological evaluation, or psychiatric diagnostic tool.
about.faq3Q: Are my test choices or archetype results saved on external servers?
about.faq3A: Never. All 16 binary dilemma evaluations and archetype scores are computed 100% locally within your device browser. No personal responses or results are tracked, collected, or stored externally.
